overloads.semanticRole: Tests whether the calling database/component context (or, if * is passed from a component, the host database) is running in compiled (True) or interpreted (False) mode.

constraints: The optional * parameter is only meaningful in a components architecture: when called from a component method, passing * returns the running mode of the HOST database instead of the component; omitting it returns the component's own running mode.
When called from a method of the host database itself, always returns the host database's running mode regardless of *.
